about_the_game:
This is an 18+game that incorporates RPG elements and simulation management gameplay. The game is developed by a game development company. You will play the role of an entrepreneurial youth, striving hard to create your dream game.

1. Gameplay:

The game uses the left mouse button to move the protagonist, and interacts with characters and items in the scene through the space bar.

2. Content:

In the game, you can choose to create games with different themes according to your preferences. In the process of operation, you will recruit various special talents, not only beautiful women, but also many legendary figures in the gaming industry. While running a game company, you can interact with employees in various ways. Every girl has weaknesses, finding them can conquer them. Is it to create a timeless masterpiece or to use the company's name to harm female employees. Everything depends on you.

3. Features:

Although this game is a simulation management game, we have incorporated many RPG elements. This is the fourth installment in this series, and I believe it will bring a different experience to everyone in all aspects.
